name: AgentBase
identity: AgentBase is operated by AgentBase LLC, a Wyoming limited liability company founded in August 2026. We build and operate AI agent fleets that run real business operations.
business: We operate client workloads (Run), embed agent fleets in companies (Build), and ship working systems in two-week engagements (Prove).
mission: Our goal is to replace human operating labor with software organizations. People set the direction and remain accountable.
missionScope: This is our long-term direction. The products and tools described here are individual building blocks at different stages of development.
teamWorkScope: Selected work from our team, including projects begun before AgentBase LLC. These products and tools are building blocks for our ambition; they are not yet one autonomous company.
